(async () => { const base = { seasons: [2026], gameTypes: ['regular'] }; const p = (metrics, scope = base, transform = 'perGame') => ({ entity: 'player', metrics: [...metrics, 'min'], scope, transform, sort: { metric: 'min', dir: 'desc' }, limit: 5000 }); const out = {}; const run = async (k, q) => { out[k] = await timed(q) }; await run('players usage/ts', p(['usg_pct', 'ts_pct'])); await run('players fg3a/fg3_pct', p(['fg3a', 'fg3_pct'])); await run('players pts/drives + ast + ts', p(['pts', 'drives', 'ast', 'ts_pct'])); await run('same, totals', p(['pts', 'drives', 'ast', 'ts_pct'], base, 'raw')); await run('same, date range', p(['pts', 'drives', 'ast', 'ts_pct'], { ...base, dates: ['2025-11-01', '2026-01-31'] })); await run('usage/ts, last 10', p(['usg_pct', 'ts_pct'], { ...base, lastN: 10, lastNOf: 'appearances' })); await run('centers play-in', p(['usg_pct', 'ts_pct'], { seasons: [2026], gameTypes: ['play-in'], positions: ['C'] })); await run('teams ortg/drtg + win pct', { entity: 'team', metrics: ['team_ortg', 'team_drtg', 'team_win_pct'], scope: base, transform: 'perGame', sort: { metric: 'team_ortg', dir: 'desc' }, limit: 5000 }); return 'engine timings ' + JSON.stringify(out) })()

(async () => { const r = await window.api.stats.query({ entity: 'player', metrics: ['usg_pct', 'ts_pct', 'fg3a', 'fg3_pct', 'min'], scope: { seasons: [2026], gameTypes: ['regular'] }, transform: 'perGame', sort: { metric: 'min', dir: 'desc' }, limit: 5000 }); return 'values ' + JSON.stringify(r.rows.slice(0, 6).map((x) => [x.id, x.name, x.games, ...['usg_pct', 'ts_pct', 'fg3a', 'fg3_pct', 'min'].map((m) => x.values[m].value)])) })()
